name: shein-mcp
description: SHEIN Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, set_inventory, update_listing, end_listing.

platform_mcp_shein_open_key_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_OPEN_KEY_ID
platform_mcp_shein_open_key_id.description: openKeyId returned by the store-authorisation call /open-api/auth/get-by-token (Store Authorization Application Manual); sent as x-lt-openKeyId.

platform_mcp_shein_sign_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_SIGN_KEY
platform_mcp_shein_sign_key.description: The HMAC key SHEIN's Signature Rules define as SecretKey + RandomKey: the DECRYPTED secretKey from /open-api/auth/get-by-token (it is returned AES-encrypted with your appSecretKey; decrypt it once as the authorisation manual shows) immediately followed by your random_key, e.g. '6BEC9C4B668B4B14B17EEF106BB98AE5test1'. Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_shein_random_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_RANDOM_KEY
platform_mcp_shein_random_key.description: The 5-character RandomKey you choose (letters/digits, e.g. 'test1'); it prefixes every x-lt-signature and must equal the last 5 characters of sign_key.

platform_mcp_shein_site.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_SITE
platform_mcp_shein_site.description: SHEIN sub-site for price and shelf changes, e.g. shein-us, shein-mx, shein-fr (店铺站点和币种信息 /open-api/openapi-business-backend/site/query).

platform_mcp_shein_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_shein_currency.description: Selling currency of that site for price changes, e.g. USD, MXN, EUR.

platform_mcp_shein_warehouse_code.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_WAREHOUSE_CODE
platform_mcp_shein_warehouse_code.description: Merchant warehouse code (from `me`) for stock updates; required when the store has several warehouses.

tools.name: me
tools.description: 商家仓库列表查询: the store's warehouses (warehouseCode, warehouseName, saleCountryList, warehouseType 1 = merchant warehouse); verifies openKeyId and signature.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: 请求订单列表: orders issued on ONE calendar day — `since` (YYYY-MM-DD, required) selects that day 00:00:00–23:59:00 in Beijing time (the API accepts at most a 48-hour window). `status` is SHEIN's numeric orderStatus: 1 pending, 2 to ship, 3 awaiting SHEIN shipment, 4 shipped, 5 delivered, 6 refunded, 7 awaiting pickup, 8 reported lost, 9 rejected. Line items: /open-api/order/order-detail (not mapped).

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: 更新商家库存接口v2: overwrites the merchant virtual stock of SHEIN sku_code `sku` (required) with `quantity` (reserved/occupied units cannot be removed). Per-SKU failures are in raw.info.failedList.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: 更新商品售价: sets the shop price of SKU `listing_id` (SHEIN sku_code) on the configured site/currency; the special price is reset. status 1 = done, 2 = waiting for price review (wait for the review webhook before changing it again), 0 = failed.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: 商品上下架: takes SKC `listing_id` (skc_name) off the shelf on the configured site. The same SKC+site cannot be changed again within 20 minutes; check `failures`.
